name: drag-items

frames.best_why: All three task cards sit neatly in their original order with every grip, date and button visible.

tagline: White task cards slide up and down the list when pulled by their dot grip.
summary: A narrow stack of white task cards, each with a title, a line of detail, a due date, a black Open task button and a nine-dot grip on the right. Dragging a grip lifts its card while the rest slide aside to make room.
appearance: Three white rounded task cards stacked with small gaps on a black page. Each shows a bold title, a faint subtitle, a small date row and a black Open task button, with a pale nine-dot grip at the right edge.
behaviour: Pressing a grip lifts its card with a soft shadow and shrinks the grip slightly; the card follows the pointer while the rows below slide to close the gap. Releasing drops it into the new position and the list settles with a spring.
demo_content: Tasks about shipping a checklist, fixing a flaky test and writing release notes, dated late 2024.
search_phrases: drag task cards to reorder a list
sortable todo list with grip handle
vertical list that springs into place
reorder rows by pulling the dots
task list you can rearrange by hand
todo cards with due dates and buttons
draggable rows with a lift shadow
issue list for a project board
use_when: A short task or issue list needs manual reordering by dragging rather than by a sort menu.
avoid_when: Only the small grip starts a drag, the order never persists, and the list is capped at a narrow column.
customise: No props: the three tasks, their dates and links are written into the state in the file, and the grip, shadow spring and max width live in the source.
weight_why: Three DOM rows and a spring that only runs while a card is dragged.

a11y.note: The grip is a button labelled Reorder, but only pointer drag reorders, so there is no keyboard path and no reduced-motion handling.

issues: All task links point to # and the Open task buttons lead nowhere.
The new order lives in page state only, so a reload resets it.
Nothing tells the user that only the small grip starts a drag.
polish_why: Clean white task rows and a convincing lift; plain styling and placeholder links.
title: Draggable Reorder List
